meta.title: Workspace list dock
meta.description: Dock the workspace / session list to the left, right, top or bottom edge from Settings → General; it can auto-hide to an edge line and reappear on hover, and the plugin rail stays on the left.

position.title: Workspace list dock
position.desc: Move the workspace / session list to another edge; the plugin rail stays on the left.
position.hint: Away from the left the host resize handle is hidden; pick "Left" to restore.
position.locked: The sidebar is collapsed right now — expand it, then pick the edge again.
position.peekOn: Collapsed to a thin line; hover near that edge to reveal it.
position.peekOff: Always visible — it keeps occupying that edge.
